verdict.rationale: BILL Spend & Expense markets AI-powered spend management and an AI Invoice Coding Agent, so a training-data opt-out is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents an AI-training opt-out, a data-use policy, or any control that keeps customer data out of model training. The docs MCP server and llms.txt are developer resources for AI tools and do not address training-data use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
